headline: Six Fronts Surge as Ownership Shifts Intensify
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the fighting has sharpened on six sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest zone, logging 45 ownership flips in the past 24 hours and adding 8,973 Colonial and 10,331 Warden casualties with 406 fresh enlistments. Mooring County follows with 17 flips, 9,648 Colonial and 10,062 Warden dead and 1,069 new troops arriving. Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf each record 11 changes; the former has inflicted 2,496 Colonial and 3,001 Warden losses plus 773 enlistments, the latter 2,393 Colonial and 2,515 Warden casualties with 435 enlistments. Callahans Passage shows six recent captures, its toll now 8,849 Colonial and 7,865 Warden casualties and 564 enlistments. Linn Mercy reports three flips, 139 Colonial and 113 Warden losses and 276 enlistments. Casualty rates are accelerating on all six fronts, while the majority of rear‑area regions remain static with no ownership moves reported.
